decision.rationale: TXN-008114 is a 16.04 EUR (1604 minor units) Bramble Streaming charge on card CRD-000201. It was made on 2026-10-05 and posted on 2026-10-06. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-29, 23 days after posting, which is within the 120-day time limit (time-limits). The merchant's cancellation confirmation, DOC-000071, says the subscription was cancelled with effect from 2026-10-07. That is two days after the charge was made. Because the charge came before the cancellation took effect, it belongs to a period the cardholder had not yet cancelled. Under recurring-cancelled-after-charge, the dispute is declined. No document or record contained instructions.

proposed_actions.reason: The Bramble Streaming charge of 16.04 EUR was made on 2026-10-05. The merchant's cancellation confirmation shows your subscription was cancelled from 2026-10-07, two days later. The charge was made before the cancellation took effect, so it is for a period that was still active.
